contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: slice(-5,-1) is 5678, size four; reversed range is empty; clamped prefix is 012; omitted type is empty.
contract.distinctness: Byte-range interpretation and slice metadata; no stream or transport slicing.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(await middle.text(), '5678', 'negative endpoints are relative to Blob size');
t.equal(middle.type, 'application/x-slice', 'slice has independently normalized content type');
t.equal(await blob.slice(8, 3).text(), '', 'reversed range yields empty Blob');
t.equal(await blob.slice(-99, 3).text(), '012', 'negative start clamps to beginning');
t.equal(blob.slice(0, 2).type, '', 'omitted slice type does not inherit source type');
t.equal(await blob.text(), '0123456789', 'slicing leaves source bytes unchanged');
contract.hypothesis: Negative, reversed, or clamped slice ranges may be handled as string positions or inherit the original type incorrectly.
contract.mechanism: Blob slice endpoint normalization and independent slice metadata
